next.reason: 1985: 'there must not be the execution of any statement that would cause the execution of a USE procedure that had previously been invoked'; 2023: 'if a statement raises an exception condition that would cause the execution of a USE procedure ... the EC-FLOW-USE exception condition is set to exist'. 1985 forbids re-entering an active USE procedure and leaves the outcome undefined. 2023 instead defines the outcome: the EC-FLOW-USE exception condition is set to exist.
